nodes.text: #1170 : [Va99,7.86] set theory | ramsey theory Laver [La82] proved the consistency of $\omega_2\to (\omega_12+1,\alpha)^2$ for all $\alpha<\omega_2$. Foreman and Hajnal [FoHa03] proved the consistency of $\omega_2\to (\omega_1^2+1,\alpha)^2$ for all $\alpha<\omega_2$.
